newsitem.title: USA: Adelphia says to sell $100 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: Adelphia says to sell $100 mln preferred.

text.p: Adelphia Communications Corp said Monday it agreed to privately place $100 million worth of convertible preferred stock.
The company said the shares are being sold to members of the family of Adelphia Chairman John Rigas and to Telesat Cablevision Inc, a wholly owned unit of FPL Group Inc.
Adelphia also said it is proposing to offer $150 million in senior notes due 2007 and $150 million in exchangeable preferred stock due 2009.

The convertible preferred stock will accrue dividends at the rate of 8-1/8 percent of the liquidation preference, and will be convertible at $8.48 per share into an aggregate of about 11.8 million Adelphia Class A common shares.
The completion of the two prposed offerings is conditioned upon completion of the convertible preferred stock sale.
Adelphia plans to use the proceeds from the offerings to repay debt owed by its units.
